core_classification.analysis: The direct statement “jag har aldrig kunnat älska någon annan än dig” (“I have never been able to love anyone other than you”) primarily avows a persistent and exclusive loving state. It does not itself undertake a commitment, and the surrounding urgency does not establish that the words function as a reflex-like expressive discharge.
core_classification.ambiguity: The avowal is used within an urgent relational appeal, but that pragmatic purpose does not give the core statement independent performative force.

utterance_status.description: A speaker directly addresses Gösta and avows having been unable to love anyone other than him.

contextual_interpretation: The avowal supports pleas for forgiveness and against abandonment: “Förlåt mig! Överge mig inte!” The speaker also casts Gösta as the only person who can save her from herself. This makes the declaration desperate and potentially persuasive, but its core force remains a truth-conditional avowal of exclusive love rather than a commitment or independently evidenced reflexive discharge.

evidence.quotation_or_description: “Gösta, jag har aldrig kunnat älska någon annan än dig” (“Gösta, I have never been able to love anyone other than you”).
evidence.supports: The first-person perfect construction explicitly presents exclusive, enduring love for Gösta as true, strongly supporting T.

evidence.quotation_or_description: “Förlåt mig! Överge mig inte!” (“Forgive me! Do not abandon me!”).
evidence.supports: The avowal occurs within an urgent plea for forgiveness and continued attachment, explaining its persuasive context without turning the core love statement into an undertaking.

evidence.quotation_or_description: “Du är den ende, som kan frälsa mig från mig själv” (“You are the only one who can save me from myself”).
evidence.supports: The speaker frames Gösta as uniquely necessary, reinforcing desperation and exclusivity but not independently establishing P or E in the core utterance.

ontology_assessment.diagnosis: T naturally captures the core avowal. Its urgent persuasive setting can be described contextually, with no residual core force requiring P, E, or O.

notes: The English renderings are analytical translations of the supplied Swedish, not source-text quotations.
